en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground are sloping fields and fenced gardens, with several detached houses and villas in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century Central European style. Further back, more multi‑storey houses and guesthouse‑like buildings stand along a gently rising road, with dense coniferous forest covering the hill behind. At the top left of the image, printed text reads "Bärenfels i. sächs. Erzgeb."
